description: This file defines the SimpleTemplateNameParser class within the Goteo\Util\Form namespace. It implements the TemplateNameParserInterface to parse template names and convert them into TemplateReference objects, handling relative and absolute template paths.

classes.name: SimpleTemplateNameParser
classes.description: A parser class for template names, converting them into TemplateReference instances, considering root path and template name syntax.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a root path.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a template name, replacing colon with slash if present, and creating a TemplateReference object with the resulting path.
